measured.topAndBottomCollars: A single SOLID rounded-diamond section (one contour, no hole) atZ=.2 and7.8; four disconnected local sections atZ1 and4. Source is an open-sided cage with thin endplates, not a solid extrusion or hollow ring collar.

adaptation.preserved: Two solid rounded-diamond endplates and four mid-height corner knees. Source end contours and four-post topology derive from actual sections. No convex hull or private-mesh redistribution.
adaptation.changed: Original anisotropic elongated diamond cage58–76×36–48×12–20mm. Proposed3–4mm circular rods,1.6–2.4mm plates and.6–.8 knee reach. Original source web transitions replaced with two rods per knee, joining successive cardinal roots. No interlocking pitches or clearances retained; this is a monolithic free-tumble fidget, not fabric.
adaptation.personalization: Central6.5mm-radius underside engraving,.4–.6mm deep, >=1mm backing. Roots are at least13mm from center; imports stay clear of them.
adaptation.mechanism: Three unequal principal inertias, actual mesh integrated at uniform density. Intermediate-axis free rotation is unstable in rigid-body theory; no physical toss test or reliable flip count claimed.
adaptation.print: Support required under upper collar and inward struts; no print-in-place interface or moving assembly.100% infill necessary for modeled mass distribution.
